<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>
<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI Policy and Growth:</strong> The RBI maintained the repo rate at 5.15% while projecting a 6.9% real GDP growth for the current fiscal year, citing ongoing concerns over inflation and oil price volatility.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOTGFSNzg0VzlJdnMwYWh2TzliX3libXhnd0pFajdsbW05R3dZU3Y5V3BjRU5uV2Q0aDVOZWZNX3dDdHpvNXpGOXRTQlNnQVRScklzNU5QdjVmV2YzOWlFVWZXMXFSZWxscFJIdFY0UHhleHZreWhkRmhqNGpCeTBYTVlpZ3AxcFN5X0h6SkFqSHJzSTBhWER6N1lkQXB3cnlLRXU4TF95ZjNWdC01XzBkTm0zOGN3RmpXc1lQSkdR?oc=5">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Correction:</strong> The Indian stock market has faced significant pressure, with the Sensex and Nifty retreating from recent peaks by 5,035 and 1,453 points respectively, shifting investor focus toward the upcoming budget for potential recovery cues.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5">I4</a></span></li>
</ul>
<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>
<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Yields and Commodities:</strong> Two-year bond yields have dipped amid rising Hormuz trade flows and growing optimism regarding inflation, while gold and silver ETFs have seen a decline due to persistent concerns over Federal Reserve rate policies.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5">W2</a></span></li>
</ul>
